CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rh_asset.detail_attachment_matches(aid text, v integer, fid text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'rh_asset'
AS $function$ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.research_artifact_file f JOIN public.research_artifact a ON a.id=f."artifactId" JOIN rh_asset.version_policy p ON p.asset_id=a.id AND p.artifact_version_id=f."artifactVersionId" WHERE f.id=fid AND a.id=aid AND p.version_no=v AND v=1 AND f."tenantId"=p.tenant_id AND f."studyGroupId"=p.study_group_id AND f."researchProjectId"=p.research_project_id AND f.role='source_attachment' AND CASE WHEN a."idempotencyKey"='rh-research-asset:detail-20261113:owner:protocol' AND a."ownerAccountId"='rh-kb-local-b0e2af9d-owner' AND f.id='rh-a02-file-02cc9a65f1d32db0723a11ff0c735d42' AND f.filename='a02-owner-protocol.md' AND f.sha256='bcf0e5a1bbbdecc2abe9866517eb73cf492e155f1b25d8fedbff0a4f56c41a7c' AND f."sizeBytes"=173 AND f."storageKey"='rh-kb-local-b0e2af9d-tenant/hub-a02-files/rh-a02-file-02cc9a65f1d32db0723a11ff0c735d42.md' AND f."mimeType"='text/markdown; charset=utf-8' THEN true WHEN a."idempotencyKey"='rh-research-asset:detail-20261113:owner:dataset' AND a."ownerAccountId"='rh-kb-local-b0e2af9d-owner' AND f.id='rh-a02-file-edd38b0d4978570107845c87ba07b05e' AND f.filename='a02-owner-dataset.txt' AND f.sha256='86698ee2de4f86ce2850d467e3d0a5894d5b88476985aac2c98543a77c2ad896' AND f."sizeBytes"=173 AND f."storageKey"='rh-kb-local-b0e2af9d-tenant/hub-a02-files/rh-a02-file-edd38b0d4978570107845c87ba07b05e.txt' AND f."mimeType"='text/plain; charset=utf-8' THEN true WHEN a."idempotencyKey"='rh-research-asset:detail-20261113:admin:protocol' AND a."ownerAccountId"='rh-kb-local-b0e2af9d-admin' AND f.id='rh-a02-file-8912d37ef7c5b648e0b91f0ecd064861' AND f.filename='a02-admin-protocol.md' AND f.sha256='bcf0e5a1bbbdecc2abe9866517eb73cf492e155f1b25d8fedbff0a4f56c41a7c' AND f."sizeBytes"=173 AND f."storageKey"='rh-kb-local-b0e2af9d-tenant/hub-a02-files/rh-a02-file-8912d37ef7c5b648e0b91f0ecd064861.md' AND f."mimeType"='text/markdown; charset=utf-8' THEN true WHEN a."idempotencyKey"='rh-research-asset:detail-20261113:admin:dataset' AND a."ownerAccountId"='rh-kb-local-b0e2af9d-admin' AND f.id='rh-a02-file-8ce3e1894820b91d7f2d873c431c7457' AND f.filename='a02-admin-dataset.txt' AND f.sha256='86698ee2de4f86ce2850d467e3d0a5894d5b88476985aac2c98543a77c2ad896' AND f."sizeBytes"=173 AND f."storageKey"='rh-kb-local-b0e2af9d-tenant/hub-a02-files/rh-a02-file-8ce3e1894820b91d7f2d873c431c7457.txt' AND f."mimeType"='text/plain; charset=utf-8' THEN true ELSE false END) $function$
